env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd s
! logos build ./...
stderr 'DeferClosure\(\) is dropped'
stderr 'AddrTaken\(\) is dropped'
stderr 'RangeAssign\(nil\) is dropped'
stderr 'CalledClosure\(\) is dropped'
stderr 'RecoverAssign\(\) is dropped'
! stderr 'Control\(\) is dropped'
cd ..

cd s/c
logos build -o $WORK/s.a .
cd ../..
go tool pack p $WORK/s.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Control AlwaysNilError$'
! stdout '^fn DeferClosure '
! stdout '^fn AddrTaken '
! stdout '^fn RangeAssign '
! stdout '^fn CalledClosure '
! stdout '^fn RecoverAssign '

-- s/go.mod --
module example.com/s

go 1.27

-- s/c/c.lgo --
package c

import "errors"

var errBad = errors.New("bad")

func DeferClosure() (err error) {
	defer func() { err = errBad }()
	return nil
}

func AddrTaken() (err error) {
	p := &err
	*p = errBad
	return nil
}

func RangeAssign(errs []error) (err error) {
	for _, err = range errs {
	}
	return nil
}

func CalledClosure() (err error) {
	func() { err = errBad }()
	return nil
}

func RecoverAssign() (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			err = errBad
		}
	}()
	return nil
}

func Control() error {
	return nil
}

-- s/d/d.lgo --
package d

import "example.com/s/c"

func Use() {
	c.DeferClosure()
	c.AddrTaken()
	c.RangeAssign(nil)
	c.CalledClosure()
	c.RecoverAssign()
	c.Control()
}
